title: nf-austin/echidna pipeline parameters
description: Bayesian gene dosage inference from scRNA-seq and (optionally) bulk WGS copy number

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Where the data comes from and where results go. Provide either a samplesheet or a discovery directory.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV listing the samples to run.
input.help_text: Columns: `sample`, `h5ad`, and optional `seg_txt`. Leave `seg_txt` blank to run that sample in no-WGS mode. Required for multi-timepoint runs, where the h5ad is pre-concatenated. Use this rather than `--scrna_dir` when launching from Seqera Platform. Mutually exclusive with `--scrna_dir`.

wgs_dir.description: Auto-discovery: an nf-austin/wgs-cna output directory. Optional.
wgs_dir.help_text: Expects `{wgs_dir}/{sample}.seg.txt`. Omit to run every sample in no-WGS mode. Applies to `--scrna_dir` mode only.

sample_map.description: CSV (scrna_sample,wgs_sample) bridging mismatched naming between the two directories.
sample_map.help_text: A blank `wgs_sample`, or an scRNA sample absent from the map, runs that sample in no-WGS mode rather than skipping it. Applies to `--scrna_dir` mode only.

outdir.description: Output directory. Use an absolute path on a cluster or on cloud storage.

reference_options.title: Reference options
reference_options.description: Gene coordinates used to map WGS segments onto genes.

gene_bed.description: Existing refGene BED (chr, start, end, gene_name). Skips the UCSC download.
gene_bed.help_text: Prefer this on HPC: compute nodes frequently have no outbound network, so the automatic download fails. Fetch it once on a login node and pass the path here.

genome.description: UCSC genome name used to auto-download the refGene BED.
genome.help_text: Only used when `--gene_bed` is not given. Requires the compute node to reach hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu.

preprocessing_options.title: Pre-processing options
preprocessing_options.description: Clustering and dimensionality reduction applied before training.

num_genes.description: Number of highly variable genes to keep. Unset uses every gene.

n_comps.description: Principal components used for the neighbourhood graph.

n_neighbors.description: Nearest neighbours for the scanpy neighbourhood graph.

val_split.description: Fraction of cells held out for validation.

patience.description: Early-stopping patience, in steps. Unset disables early stopping.

inverse_gamma.description: Use an inverse-gamma prior for eta variance.
inverse_gamma.help_text: Set automatically for samples running without WGS, where the extra flexibility helps. This flag applies it to WGS samples too.

timepoint_label.description: obs column holding the timepoint label.

clusters.description: obs column holding the cluster assignment.

cnv_options.title: CNV inference options
cnv_options.description: How echi_cnv turns gene dosage into copy number states.

n_hmm_components.description: HMM states used to segment the genome.

n_gmm_components.description: GMM components used to find the neutral state.

neut_method.description: How the neutral copy number level is chosen.
neut_method.help_text: Passed straight through to echidna's echi_cnv(); this pipeline does not constrain the value. See the upstream docs for the accepted options.

gaussian_smoothing.description: Smooth gene dosage along the genome before segmentation.

smoother_radius.description: Gaussian smoothing radius, a non-negative integer.

tumor_calling_options.title: Tumor cell calling
tumor_calling_options.description: Optional aneuploid/diploid calls and chromosomal instability scoring.

call_tumor_cells.description: Derive per-clone and per-cell aneuploid/diploid calls plus a CIN diversity index.
call_tumor_cells.help_text: Adds the CALL_TUMOR_CELLS step, which runs on echi_cnv output and writes the clone and cell call CSVs.

tumor_frac_altered_threshold.description: Clone-level fraction of non-neutral genes above which a clone is called aneuploid.

container_options.title: Container options
container_options.description: Which image the processes run in.

echidna_container.description: Image used by every process in this pipeline.

execution_options.title: Execution environment
execution_options.description: Cluster scheduler, image caches and bind mounts. Relevant when running on HPC.
execution_options.help_text: Use the `slurm` profile together with an engine profile: `-profile slurm,singularity`. On Seqera Platform a SLURM compute environment already sets the executor, so you normally only need the cache and bind settings here.

slurm_queue.help_text: Only used with `-profile slurm`. Left unset, no --partition flag is emitted and the cluster default applies.

cluster_options.description: Raw sbatch options appended to every job, e.g. '--qos=long' or '--gres=gpu:1'.
cluster_options.help_text: RUN_ECHIDNA benefits from a GPU. The SLURM executor ignores Nextflow's `accelerator` directive, so request one here and raise `--max_forks_echidna` if the GPU has headroom.

singularity_cache_dir.description: Shared directory for pulled Singularity images.
singularity_cache_dir.help_text: Put this on shared storage the compute nodes can read. $HOME is quota-limited and is not always mounted on compute nodes. Defaults to NXF_SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR, then Nextflow's own $NXF_HOME location.

conda_cache_dir.description: Shared directory for created conda environments.

singularity_bind.description: Extra paths to bind into the container, comma-separated, e.g. '/mnt/gpfs,/scratch'.
singularity_bind.help_text: autoMounts only binds paths Nextflow itself resolved. HPC filesystems are routinely symlinked (/data -> /mnt/gpfs/...), which shows up as 'file not found' inside the container even though the host path exists. Bind the real parent here.

max_job_request_options.title: Maximum job request options
max_job_request_options.description: Caps and concurrency limits applied to every process.

max_cpus.description: Maximum CPUs for any single job.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory for any single job.

max_time.description: Maximum time for any single job.

max_forks_echidna.help_text: Kept at 1 by default because RUN_ECHIDNA is the GPU-bound step; raise it if the GPU has headroom or you are running on CPU.

help.description: Print the help message and exit.
